title: Code-derived infrastructure inventory reconciled to provider APIs
objective: Detect any cloud resource or endpoint not declared in infrastructure-as-code or device management, and record owner, environment, classification and tenant cell for each.

title: Signed SBOM per release including Echelon frameworks and AI components
objective: Produce a complete, signed component inventory for every release with versions, hashes, licenses and provenance, extended with AI models, prompts and tools.
notes: 2026-11-25 refinement-agent: framework_refs: replaced superseded SRC-NTIA-SBOM-MIN with SRC-CISA-SBOM-MIN. 2026-11-25 refinement-agent: framework_refs: Replaced superseded SRC-OWASP-LLM-TOP10-2025 with SRC-OWASP-LLM-TOP10-2026; locators remapped to 2026 numbering (LLM03:2025 to LLM04:2026).

title: Dependency allowlist and end-of-life detection
objective: Prevent unapproved, unlicensed or unsupported components (including unsupported runtimes and PostgreSQL majors) from entering a build.
implementing_systems: Strata (refuses deployment across PostgreSQL major versions)

title: Schema-checked data inventory and SharedStoreRegister
objective: Fail a release when a persistent store, cross-tenant store or column is deployed without an inventory entry naming classification, isolation key and sharing rule.
implementing_systems: Strata (candidate source of declared relational schema)
residual_risks: Does not cover unstructured copies outside declared stores.

title: Third-party service register and attack-surface monitoring
objective: Maintain a register of third-party services with data received and criticality, require approval of new SaaS and AI tools, and monitor external exposure for unexpected endpoints.

title: Declarative database schema, grants and RLS with pre-deploy diff
objective: Ensure PostgreSQL schema, privileges and row-level security policies are declared in version control and compared to the live database before every deployment, with not-compared and unverifiable items disclosed and treated as failures for mandatory objects.
residual_risks: Strata is pilot status and not independently validated.
Objects Strata reports as not-modelled require separate review.
notes: Strata's README states RLS policies are created and compared and are never dropped automatically; grants are compared per grantee and a grantee the project never names is untouched, which means undeclared roles' privileges are not reported unless separately checked.

title: Infrastructure-as-code with CIS-derived baselines and continuous drift detection
objective: Ensure hosts, containers and cloud services are configured from versioned baselines derived from CIS Benchmarks, with drift detected and reverted or escalated.

title: Asset lifecycle with verifiable tenant-scoped destruction
objective: Ensure retired assets and exiting tenants have credentials revoked, data destroyed by tenant-key destruction under dual control or provider-attested sanitization, and a destruction certificate that states what persists.
